name: quality-of-information-check
description: Use when evidence needs grading before anyone reasons from it: "how reliable is this?", "grade this source", "check this report", "is this corroborated?", or a URL, pasted report or Liberty91 event handed over ahead of an ACH or assessment. Resolves each document to its originating source, splits it into claims and grades each on access level and claim support with a rationale and hard caps; not an Admiralty rating. Returns a graded claim table, gaps, a deception screen and JSON. Run first by /ach, /threat-assessment and /writing-assessments.
